specification.objective: Supersede team-normal-surfaces-v1: soften selected team cards, icons, tabs and remaining profile surfaces in normal themes while preserving high contrast and accessibility.

requirements.statement: Supersede v1 selection: normal selected team cards, icons and tabs use subtle theme colors distinct from unselected; high contrast preserves strong selected colors.
Preserve responsive layout, semantic information, interaction, focus and unrelated shared components.
Exercise selected and unselected cards, icons, badges, tabs, real global contrast toggle, light/dark, keyboard focus and semantics.
Store byte-identical locked contract at declared path.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Employee surfaces and selection use correct theme tokens in normal and high contrast across brightness and viewport.
Interaction, focus and semantics are preserved without collateral changes.
The committed-scope contract copy equals the locked bytes.

invariants.statement: Content, responsive layout and unrelated shared component behavior remain unchanged.

forbidden_states.statement: Normal employee surfaces use high-contrast-style outlines or explicit high contrast is weakened.

inputs.statement: Employee list and profile widgets and global theme.

outputs.statement: Normalized scoped surfaces and regression coverage.

failure_semantics.statement: Widget regression fails if employee surfaces use wrong theme colors.

argv: from pathlib import Path; import sys; p=Path('docs/contracts/team-normal-surfaces-v2.polis.json'); print('contract_present' if p.is_file() else 'contract_missing'); sys.exit(0 if p.is_file() else 1)
